projection_bound_form: eta_geom_AB <= Pi_R0 * C_Obs_e * Dq_Z_norm plus source/readout residuals
required_inputs: C_Obs_e; Dq_Z_norm; N_Z; arena response Pi; same-frame source/readout map; no-cancellation guard

projection_bound_form: |gamma-1| <= Pi_gamma * C_Obs_e * Dq_Z_norm plus R_AB/J_q and calibration residuals
required_inputs: C_Obs_e; Dq_Z_norm; N_Z; arena response Pi; same-frame source/readout map; no-cancellation guard

required_inputs: C_Obs_e; Dq_Z_norm; N_Z; arena response Pi; same-frame source/readout map; no-cancellation guard

projection_bound_form: |alpha_predicted(lambda)| <= Pi_R10(lambda) * C_Obs_e * Dq_Z_norm with full 1503 coefficient chain
required_inputs: C_Obs_e; Dq_Z_norm; N_Z; arena response Pi; same-frame source/readout map; no-cancellation guard

required_inputs: C_Obs_e; Dq_Z_norm; N_Z; arena response Pi; same-frame source/readout map; no-cancellation guard

why_Cqm_DqZ_matters: preferred-frame vector terms can be induced if the coframe leak carries a frame direction

required_inputs: C_Obs_e; Dq_Z_norm; N_Z; arena response Pi; same-frame source/readout map; no-cancellation guard

required_inputs: C_Obs_e; Dq_Z_norm; N_Z; arena response Pi; same-frame source/readout map; no-cancellation guard

required_inputs: C_Obs_e; Dq_Z_norm; N_Z; arena response Pi; same-frame source/readout map; no-cancellation guard
